description: Appends a new message to the maintenance timeline ("started", "in progress", "completed", "postponed"). If `published_at` is omitted, the server stamps "now"; if provided, it must satisfy `started_at <= published_at <= now` — pre-announce updates before the window starts are not supported, and future-dated updates are rejected too.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

published_at.description: ISO 8601. Must be between the maintenance `started_at` and now (inclusive). Omit to let the server stamp the current time.

name: status_page_maintenance_update_add
title: Add timeline update to planned maintenance
